title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Fresher / Junior)
company_tier: High-Growth Product Companies & Global Tech Services
job_description:
We are looking for an energetic Full-Stack Software Engineer to build end-to-end features spanning responsive web frontends and resilient cloud backends.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop interactive user interfaces using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- Build robust RESTful backend APIs and microservices using Node.js / Express or Python / FastAPI.
- Design and maintain relational database schemas using PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality across the full stack.
- Deploy and containerize web services using Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

Minimum Qualifications:
- B.Tech / B.E. / MCA in Computer Science or related degree.
- Practical full-stack project portfolio showcasing frontend and backend integration.
- Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript or Python.
- Working knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, Git, and RESTful architectural principles.
min_education: B.Tech / B.E. / MCA in CS / IT
